item.tib: rma rgyal pom ra'i bstod bskul
item.coloph: ces pa'i bstan gnyis gling pa'i gter sras yin khul/ bstan 'dzin tshul khrims bdag rang lo bcu gsum thog khyung nag pho brang la rnam 'jom bsnyen sgrub thun mtshams/ me rta zla tshes la tho rangs mdun gyi bar snang la/ gshen lha 'od dkar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro pom ra la saugs bon skyong bstan srung rnams sprin 'khrig pa ltar/ mngon sum lhang nger gsal ba'i/ de rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu rda (brda) rtags gsum gyi rgyas gdab cing*/ brnyan (snyan) du brgyud bzhin bcos pa'i med kyi (pa med par) phab pas bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur cig/
